name: Cry of the Thunderhawk
summary: In the southern Barrens, Cry of the Thunderhawk brings a hunter to the final trial. Entrusted by Camp Taurajo's elders, you seek a winged serpent in the scrublands and return with its wings to prove mastery of the savanna's fiercest beasts.

sections.title: The Final Trial
sections.body: After hunters prove themselves against prowling plainstriders, prowlers, and agitated thunder lizards, Jorn Skyseer directs them toward their final challenge. The thunderhawk is one of the fiercest aerial predators around Camp Taurajo. Slaying one takes patience, sharp aim, and an awareness of the sky that few landbound predators possess.

sections.title: A Hunter's Walk
sections.body: Bringing back the thunderhawk's wings ends a novice's tutelage under Camp Taurajo's watch. To the tauren, hunting is no mere slaughter. It is a spiritual walk in harmony with the Earthmother and the wild's natural order. Besting this proud creature shows strength, courage, and honor, virtues needed before entering the harsher wilderness beyond the central plains.

faq.answer: Thunderhawks are winged, serpentine predators native to the Barrens. They glide over the arid plains to hunt smaller prey from above, and their lightning-quick strikes and aerial mobility command the skies around Camp Taurajo.

aliases: who starts cry of the thunderhawk
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer, a respected tauren hunter at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens, sets this trial after you prove yourself against the region's enraged thunder lizards.
Thunderhawks roam the open skies and rocky crags across the southern Barrens. They are found mainly above the plains beside the roads north and west of Camp Taurajo.

faq.q: What does claiming the wings signify to the tauren?
faq.answer: Presenting the severed wings proves that you made a clean and honorable kill. In tauren culture, taking tokens from dangerous quarry shows mastery of the beast while acknowledging the fallen creature's pride and ferocity.

faq.q: Where does this hunting trial lead next?
aliases: what comes after cry of the thunderhawk
faq.answer: When you complete Jorn Skyseer's trials, your training at Camp Taurajo ends. Jorn sends you to his sister, Mahren Skyseer, who hunts along the eastern coast of the Barrens south of Ratchet.

faq.q: How does this connect to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads?
faq.answer: This trial is the southern part of the hunting rites that began under Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads. After mastering the northern beasts, promising hunters are sent south to Camp Taurajo to continue training under Jorn Skyseer.

angles.text: For the Shu'halo, tracking the soaring thunderhawk is a sacred trial of respect and honor. It proves you can commune with and test yourself against the swiftest children of the Earthmother.
Taking down an aerial serpent like the thunderhawk tests your ranged discipline and patience. It is a formal rite of passage into true mastery of the plains.
Taming and securing the dangerous frontier around Camp Taurajo ensures the safety of Horde travelers journeying along the high road through the Barrens.
